notes.title: Cool FinTube PNGTuber App is coming!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We had previously stated that Fintube would be available on Steam once v0.3 was completed, but we believed that the feature was still in its early stages, so we waited until v0.5.

Do you want to incorporate some cutesy elements into your videos as a content creator? Desire to become a V-tuber but can't afford the character? We offer each and every one of you a really cool application. Fintube is the application's name. You can use Fintube, a pngtuber application, for your content.

These YouTubers are similar to V-Tubers in that you can make videos with any characters you like. Here, the distinction is that PNG characters are used as avatars rather than stolen ones.

This place offers you a number of features. in addition to (so far v0.4) :

[list]
[*]Supports import of JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF (Experimental) image file formats
[*]Avatar movement based on voice input from microphone
[*]A slider to set db state limits
[*]Thumbnail preview of the imported image
[*]Streamer Mode can now use "Allow Transparency" in Source>Game Capture>OBS Properties by accessing the button
[*]Multiple Expression Keys (Hotkeys) for changing between each mode/layer using keyboard
[/list]

This will all be released later on Steam. If you want the application, you can wishlist it on Steam.

Wait for our application release soon.

notes.title: Upcoming New Feature For Update v0.3
notes.content:
Welcome, our beloved Fintube community!

We miss you, and we come with wonderful news. Fintube will reveal a software update that will allow you to feel like a vtuber without having to resort to expensive budgets and high computer specs

Here's what's available to you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704116/4fcbf43917843dba246baab41187ec3598c89a41.png[/img]

- Stunning New UI: We've undergone an incredible transformation, improving our interface for your convenience. This means you can devote more time to creating captivating content and developing your digital persona.

- Multiple Expression Keys: With this feature, you can change your character's expressions with just one click of a hot key. Matching your character to your mood is easier than ever!

- Delete Feature: Replacing characters has never been easier Erase the old character image and replace it with a new character according to your wishes.
